# Setting up environment for Spatial Analysis

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 1024^3 * 10) # 10 GB
all_times <- list()  # store the time for each chunk
knitr::knit_hooks$set(time_it = local({
  now <- NULL
  function(before, options) {
    if (before) {
      now <<- Sys.time()
    } else {
      res <- difftime(Sys.time(), now, units = "secs")
      all_times[[options$label]] <<- res
    }
  }
}))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  tidy = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  time_it = TRUE,
  error = TRUE,
  dpi=150
)
```

# Dimensionality reduction, clustering

```{r dim.cluster}
GBM <- RunPCA(GBM, assay = "SCT", verbose = FALSE)
GBM <- FindNeighbors(GBM, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
GBM <- FindClusters(GBM, verbose = FALSE)
GBM <- RunUMAP(GBM, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
```

# Searching for features exhibiting spatial patterning in the absence of pre-annotation
 
Using two methods

## Moran's I Algorithm

```{r spatial.vf.moransi}
GBM <- FindSpatiallyVariableFeatures(GBM,
                                       features = VariableFeatures(GBM)[1:1000],
                                       selection.method = "moransi")
```

```{r spatial.vf.moransi.data.plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# With data

top.features <- head(SpatiallyVariableFeatures(GBM, method = "moransi"), 6)

SpatialFeaturePlot(
  GBM,
  features = top.features,
  images = NULL,
  crop = TRUE,
  slot = "data",
  keep.scale = "feature",
  min.cutoff = NA,
  max.cutoff = NA,
  ncol = 3,
  combine = TRUE,
  pt.size.factor = 2.5,
  alpha = c(2, 2),
  image.alpha = 2,
  image.scale = "lowres",
  shape = 21,
  stroke = NA,
  stroke.alpha = NA,
  interactive = FALSE,
  information = NULL,
  plot_segmentations = TRUE
) & 
  theme(plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm"))
```

'''

Interestingly, Clusters 15, 11, 13, 6, 3, 16, 12 have a common base of overly expressed group of genes (could they be actually way more similar than expected and therefore PCA is overclustering?)

'''

# Inspecting clusters and finding their TOP markers to study patterns

```{r}
table(Idents(GBM))
```

```{r}
markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  GBM,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)
```

## 10 Top Genes per cluster

```{r}
library(dplyr)

top10 <- markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = avg_log2FC,
    n = 10
  )

top10
```

```{r heatmap, fig.width=16, fig.height=14}
top5 <- top10 %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 5)

DoHeatmap(
  GBM,
  features = unique(top5$gene),
  group.by = "seurat_clusters"
) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#313695", "#74ADD1", "white", "#F46D43", "#A50026")
  ) +
  NoLegend()
```
# Possible correlation
## Identification of Spatially Variable Features using Seurat

Perform differential expression based on pre-annotated anatomical regions within the tissue, which may be determined either from unsupervised clustering or prior knowledge.

Cluster 5 and 9 have 'COL' type genes overly expressed when compared to all other clusters

```{r}
avg_sct_residuals <- as.matrix(
  AverageExpression(
    GBM,
    assays = "SCT",
    group.by = "seurat_clusters",
    layer = "scale.data"
  )$SCT
)

rho <- cor(avg_sct_residuals, method = "spearman")
cor_5_9 <- rho["g5", "g9"]

matches_5 <- sort(
  rho["g5", colnames(rho) != "g5"],
  decreasing = TRUE
)

data.frame(
  rank = seq_along(matches_5),
  cluster = sub("^g", "", names(matches_5)),
  spearman_rho = round(unname(matches_5), 3)
)

pair <- avg_sct_residuals[, c("g5", "g9")]
limits <- range(pair)

plot(
  pair[, "g5"], pair[, "g9"],
  xlim = limits, ylim = limits, asp = 1,
  pch = 16, cex = 0.55,
  col = adjustcolor("#176C72", alpha.f = 0.4),
  xlab = "Cluster 5 mean SCT residual",
  ylab = "Cluster 9 mean SCT residual",
  main = sprintf("Clusters 5 and 9 (Spearman rho = %.3f)", cor_5_9)
)
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "grey55")

```

## Mapping the clusters and gene programms

This highlights clusters 5 (Collagen), 9 (Collagen and 7 (Hypoxia) on the same H&E image.

```{r}
image_id <- Images(GBM)[1]
image_scale <- "lowres"

focus <- c("5", "9", "7")
cluster <- as.character(GBM$seurat_clusters)
GBM$focus_region <- factor(
  ifelse(cluster %in% focus, cluster, "Other"),
  levels = c(focus, "Other")
)

p_clusters <- SpatialDimPlot(
  GBM,
  group.by = "focus_region",
  images = image_id,
  image.scale = image_scale,
  pt.size.factor = 2.8,
  alpha = 1,
  image.alpha = 0.55,
  cols = c(
    "5" = "#D55E00",
    "9" = "#009E73",
    "7" = "#0072B2",
    "Other" = "grey88"
  ),
  combine = FALSE
)[[1]]

panels <- list(
  Collagen = c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1", "COL6A3", "DCN", "POSTN"),
  MES2_markers = c("DDIT3", "ENO2", "VIM", "ADM", "LDHA"),
  Hypoxia = c("CA9", "HILPDA", "ANGPTL4", "VEGFA", "NDRG1", "BNIP3"),
  MES1_markers = c("ANXA1", "ANXA2", "CHI3L1", "CD44"),
  GBM_markers = c("BCAN", "DDR1", "PTPRZ1", "NUSAP1", "TPX2", "UHRF1")
)

panels <- lapply(panels, intersect, y = rownames(GBM[["SCT"]]))
print(panels)
stopifnot(all(lengths(panels) >= 3L))

GBM <- AddModuleScore(
  GBM, features = panels, assay = "SCT", name = "Niche", seed = 42
)
GBM$Collagen <- GBM$Niche1
GBM$MES2_markers <- GBM$Niche2
GBM$Hypoxia <- GBM$Niche3
GBM$MES1_markers <- GBM$Niche4
GBM$GBM_markers <- GBM$Niche5

score_maps <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
  GBM,
  features = c(
    "Collagen", "Hypoxia",
    "MES1_markers", "MES2_markers",
    "GBM_markers"
  ),
  images = image_id,
  image.scale = image_scale,
  pt.size.factor = 2.5,
  alpha = c(1, 1),
  image.alpha = 0.55,
  keep.scale = "feature",
  combine = FALSE
)

```

```{r gbm-spatial-output, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, out.width="100%", fig.align="center"}
p_spatial <- wrap_plots(
  c(list(p_clusters), score_maps),
  ncol = 3,
  nrow = 2,
  guides = "keep"
) & ggplot2::theme(
  plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 1, r = 8, b = 1, l = 8, unit = "pt"),
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.box.spacing = grid::unit(2, "pt"),
  legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
  legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16),
  legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 18, face = "bold")
)

p_spatial
```

## Comparing Clusters highly expression MBP

```{r}
avg_expr <- AverageExpression(
  GBM,
  assays = "SCT",
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  layer = "scale.data"
)$SCT

clusters_to_compare <- c(
  "g1", "g10", "g14", "g17",
  "g8", "g12", "g16"
)

avg_expr_subset <- as.matrix(
  avg_expr[, clusters_to_compare, drop = FALSE]
)

cor_matrix <- cor(
  avg_expr_subset,
  method = "spearman"
)

round(cor_matrix, 3)

library(pheatmap)

pheatmap(
  cor_matrix,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  main = "Transcriptional correlation between clusters"
)
```


```{r}
cor_pairs <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_matrix))

cor_pairs <- cor_pairs %>%
  filter(Var1 != Var2) %>%
  mutate(
    pair = paste(
      pmin(as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)),
      pmax(as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)),
      sep = " vs "
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(desc(Freq))

cor_pairs
```
